# Security policy

Qtangl takes security reports seriously. We appreciate responsible disclosure from researchers and customers.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Email:** [charley@qtangl.com](mailto:charley@qtangl.com)  
**Subject line:** `[SECURITY]` (required for routing)

Include reproduction steps, impact assessment, and your preferred contact method.

**Full policy:** [https://www.qtangl.com/trust/disclosure](https://www.qtangl.com/trust/disclosure)

## Scope

In scope: qtangl.com, api.qtangl.com, the scanner API, and the customer dashboard.

Out of scope: social engineering, physical attacks, third-party SaaS, denial-of-service.

## Response expectations

- Acknowledgment within **2 business days**
- Coordinated disclosure default: **90 days** (extensions by mutual agreement)
- No bug bounty at this time; we credit researchers on our security page when permitted

## security.txt

Machine-readable contact: [https://www.qtangl.com/.well-known/security.txt](https://www.qtangl.com/.well-known/security.txt)
